claims.text: The WET Deck pool has a slide.

findings.quote: Dive into one of Singapore’s largest free-form pools, open 24/7 and featuring a playful slide that sparks connection and fun.

claims.text: The design uses organic shapes and greenery that echo Sentosa's flora and fauna.

findings.quote: Organic shapes and untamed greenery echo the wild beauty of Sentosa’s flora and fauna.

claims.text: Rooms have oversized beds, coral-orange sofas and private balconies.

findings.quote: expect oversized beds, coral-orange sofas, private balconies, and tech-forward touches.

claims.text: Every room has filtered water taps.

findings.quote: Make a splash with eco-friendly filtered water taps in every room, offering unlimited on-demand water

claims.text: The Penthouse has an outdoor terrace and a private plunge pool with views of the sea and marina.

findings.quote: Kick back with a cocktail on the outdoor terrace, or soak up the sun in your own private plunge pool while taking in panoramic views of the sea, marina, and WET pool.

claims.text: The hotel is set along the marina waterfront.
The hotel is near Sentosa's beaches and moments from the island's attractions.

findings.quote: As a hotel near Sentosa beaches, W Singapore – Sentosa Cove places you moments away from the island’s many attractions and seaside experiences.

claims.text: The Whatever/Whenever service can arrange scuba diving, sailing trips and island hopping.

findings.quote: Simply call Whatever/Whenever and we will assist with your scuba dive booking, sailing trip or island hopping arrangements!

claims.text: SKIRT is an open-fire steakhouse known for Wagyu, dry-aged meats and seafood cooked over a Josper grill and binchotan.

findings.quote: SKIRT is a contemporary open-fire steakhouse in Singapore, known for exceptional Wagyu, expertly dry-aged meats and seafood, and wood-fired dishes cooked over the Josper Basque Grill and binchotan.

claims.text: The WET Pool is an outdoor pool with views of the South China Sea, for swimming day or night.

findings.quote: Cool off day or night in WET Pool, our 1,338 square meter outdoor pool with views of the sparkling South China Sea.

claims.text: Some suites have private plunge pools with views of the WET pool, the marina and the South China Sea.

findings.quote: Dip your toes in your own private plunge pool while soaking up breathtaking panoramic views of WET pool, the marina, and the South China Sea.

claims.text: AWAY Spa has a rainforest design and facilities including a decompression lounge, infrared therapy, a steam room, a whirlpool and a vitality pool.

findings.quote: Lose yourself in the rainforest design and setting of AWAY Spa, where relaxing treatments combine with premier facilities, including a decompression lounge, infrared (heat) therapy, steam room, whirlpool, vitality pool

claims.text: AiRe Wellness offers therapies including hyperbaric oxygen, red light therapy and compression recovery.

findings.quote: Experience next-level therapies including Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy, Red Light Therapy, Body Composition Analysis and Compression Recovery, and more.

claims.text: The lobby has columns that bloom up like mushrooms, and the entrance has glass installations.

findings.quote: from the glass installations at the entrance, to columns in the lobby that bloom up like mushrooms, to the crescent-shaped poolside lounge chairs.
No, pets are not allowed at W Singapore - Sentosa Cove.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes it as a touch less clubby than a standard W, set in an exclusive enclave.

findings.quote: A touch less clubby than your standard W, this Sentosa Cove location occupies an exclusive enclave that’s still a sight to behold.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the island location means traveling to reach mainland Singapore attractions.
